title: Skriv brev til en tannklinikk om nye priser på skrivere
person: A customer manager at a small Norwegian office-machine dealer writing to a dental clinic that buys from it.
review: It answers the clinic's question of 30 September and states the new price of kr 6 890 from 1 January 2027, up from kr 6 450, with the reason.
revised_review: The cut-off is 1 December everywhere; 15 December appears nowhere.
